revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. Packaging added one wrapper-family issue. Brands A and B may still both run, but running both in the same month now requires a shared wrapper coordination pass costing 300 Yuan once; Brand C is unaffected. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
